none: PAS LIN-C7D7BD: Roman siliqua of Valens or Valentinian I
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ DN V[.......] AVG ; R/ RES[TITV-TOR RE]IP

An incomplete silver siliqua of Valens or Valentinian I (AD 364 to AD 378), (Reece Period 19). Pearl-diademed, draped, and cuirassed bust right RESTITV TOR REIP. Reverse type depicting Emperor standing facing, head right, holding a labarum, with cross on shaft and Victory on globe DN VALENTINI-ANVS P F AVG. Mint of Lyon (Lugdunum) PLVG. Obverse description: Pearl diademed, draped and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: DN V[.......] AVG. Reverse description: Emperor standing facing holding staff. Reverse inscription: RES[TITV-TOR RE]IP. (Surviving) Diameter: 16.27 mm; Thickness: 1.27 mm; Weight: 0.88g; DA:12
